title: Secret Formula
description: In his Dublin, Ireland-based lab, photographer Karl Gaff devised a secret formula using compounds like iron sulfate and urea to make this striking image. After spreading the mixture onto a glass slide, he heated it and then used a polarizing microscope to capture the exact moment it crystallized. The chemical process produced this vivid composition.
translated_description: 在爱尔兰都柏林的实验室里，摄影师卡尔·加夫设计了一种秘密配方，使用硫酸铁和尿素等化合物制作了这张引人注目的照片。他把混合物涂在玻璃载玻片上，加热，然后用偏光显微镜捕捉到它结晶的确切瞬间。这一化学过程产生了这幅鲜艳的作品。
